Description
Ohio Precious Metals (OPM)  are
one of the most well-known brands in the bullion market. OPM is a brand name given to the partnership between OPM (Ohio Precious Metals) and NTR (North Texas Refinery). Ohio Precious Metals has been one of the most reputable precious metals dealers in the US for a long time. It has a reputation for bringing some of the most valuable and best-looking bars and coins to people around the world. The 1 oz OPM silver bar is no exception  to this concept and comes loaded with .999 purity.
The 1 Oz silver bar by OPM is worth its price. The price of silver is expected to continuously grow. So, buying a 1-ounce OPM silver bar now will provide great value in the future.
The price in our store varies based on the quantity you buy and the payment method.
The 1 oz OPM Mint Silver Bar can be a great addition for investors looking to diversify their precious metal portfolio as the
Silver bars
are very easy to buy, store, sell and trade in the precious metal industry. As the OPM Mint is IRA certified(ISO 9001), each of the OPM Silver Bars is assured of the highest production quality and metal purity making it eligible for the Precious Metal IRAs.
Design of OPM Mint 1 oz Silver Bar
The 1 oz OPM Silver Bar features the OPM Mint logo  on the obverse. The bar’s weight and purity are inscribed just below the OPM logo
The recycled emblem is present on the back of the bar.
Main Highlights of 1 oz OPM Silver Bar
Contains 1 troy oz of .999+ fine silver.
Produced by the Ohio Precious Metals Mint.
Each Silver bar comes with protective wrapping.
Easy to buy, sell and store
